changeSet.comment: Create administrator-configured dynamic exchange rates table
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE m_exchange_rate ADD CONSTRAINT ck_exchange_rate_positive CHECK (exchange_rate > 0);

changeSet.author: fineract
fineract
changeSet.comment: Assign dynamic exchange-rate permissions to default roles
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM m_role r, m_permission p WHERE r.name = 'Super user' AND p.code IN ('READ_EXCHANGE_RATE', 'CREATE_EXCHANGE_RATE', 'UPDATE_EXCHANGE_RATE', 'DELETE_EXCHANGE_RATE', 'CONVERT_CURRENCY') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id );

INSERT INTO m_role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM m_role r, m_permission p WHERE r.name = 'Self Service User' AND p.code IN ('READ_EXCHANGE_RATE', 'CONVERT_CURRENCY') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM m_role_permission rp WHERE rp.role_id = r.id AND rp.permission_id = p.id );
